purpose: Why a year has no figure in the coverage matrix, by cause. The matrix marks a year available only when the data is present; every other year must appear here with a state and a reason. States: not_printed (the source does not print it), not_extracted (the source exists and is known but the figure is not entered), source_not_found (the document could not be located; not proof it was never published), not_collected (not looked for or not verified to exist), not_published (no official release yet), staged (collected and checked but kept off the site), provisional (part of a year). See docs/COVERAGE.md.
